name: Small-Batch Fudgy Brownies
subtitle: Half batch for the small square Pyrex glass dish (~5–5½ inch inside)
equipment: Small square Pyrex dish (glass base only), small saucepan, toothpick

macros.portion: One brownie, a quarter of the dish (about 2½ inches square).
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number.

before: Only the glass base goes in the oven, never the plastic lid.
Let the dish come to room temperature first; don't go straight from fridge to hot oven.
notes: 325°F instead of 350°F because glass holds heat and overbakes the edges. The dish size is estimated, not measured: if the inside bottom is closer to 6 inches, the brownies will be thinner, so start checking at 18–20 min.

items: ¼ cup all-purpose flour (spooned and leveled)

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Heat the oven to 325°F. Grease the dish or line it with a parchment sling.

steps.title: Melt butter
steps.body: Melt **4 Tbsp butter** in a small saucepan over low heat, then take it off the heat.

steps.title: Mix wet
steps.body: Stir **½ cup sugar** into the warm butter, then beat in **1 egg + ½ tsp vanilla** until glossy.

steps.title: Add dry
steps.body: Fold in **3 Tbsp cocoa + ¼ cup flour + ⅛ tsp salt + ⅛ tsp baking powder** until just combined.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Spread in the dish and bake 25–30 min. Start checking at 22 min. A toothpick should come out with moist crumbs, not wet batter.

steps.title: Cool
steps.body: Set the hot dish on a dry towel or rack, never a wet or cold counter. Cool at least 20 min before cutting.
